info.bio:
Nation of Ulysses era una banda de Washington, D.C. Formados en la primavera de 1988, por Ian Svenonius en la voz y trompeta, Steve Kroner en guitarra, Steve Gamboa en el bajo, y James Canty en al bateria. Tim Green se les unió en 1989 en la guitarra y the Nation of Ulysses nació. Se separaron en 1992. Svenonius, Canty, y Gamboa formaron Cupid Car Club y luego The Make-Up.

Nation of Ulysses se distinguia por sus fuertes contenidos politicos, sus extremas presentaciones en vivo y por su peculiar trata a la cultura punk y la moda.

scenes.name: Hardcore en la era del punk-pop: emocore, ska-core y post-hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Mientras las revistas anuncian la «muerte del punk», el hardcore se convierte en un movimiento que no deja pueblo sin tocar y genera subgéneros. El «emocore» (Jawbreaker, Weezer, Sunny Day Real Estate, Promise Ring, At The Drive-In, Jimmy Eat World, Seaweed); el hardcore progresivo de Washington (Nation Of Ulysses, Make-Up, Shudder To Think, Jawbox, Edsel, Lungfish, Circus Lupus, Dismemberment Plan); el «ska-core» (Operation Ivy, Rancid, Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, No Doubt); el punk-pop que llega a las listas (Green Day, Offspring, Flop, Pennywise, Pegboy, Superchunk, Queers); el garage-punk californiano (Drive Like Jehu, Rocket From The Crypt, Blink 182, Zen Guerrilla); el jazzcore (Bazooka, Iceburn); la vieja escuela (D Generation, Supersuckers, Zeke, Dropkick Murphys, Silverfish, Turbonegro) y el post-hardcore de Unwound.

podcast.title: Inspiration for Danko Jones' Look
podcast.body: This punk band was a direct inspiration for the Toronto-based band Danko Jones's formal black attire and overall visual style, demonstrating their impact on contemporary punk and rock aesthetics. "They were inspired by blues legend Robert Johnson, and a punk band called Nation of Ulysses."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formal Black Attire and Shoe Polish Ritual
xref.body: The Toronto-based band Danko Jones is characterized by its members' exclusive use of black attire, a style inspired by blues legend Robert Johnson and the punk band Nation of Ulysses. Prior to every gig, they meticulously press their clothes to ensure a formal appearance, and no tour can commence without a full supply of shoe polish, underscoring their commitment to this sharp, polished image. "Dango Jones, the Toronto band is all about dressing in black. They were inspired by blues legend Robert Johnson, and a punk band called Nation of Ulysses. They pressed their clothes before every gig to make sure they got that formal look. And no Dango Jones tour is ready to start with a full supply of shoe polish."
